evidence_scope_note: This is one predeclared lag-one candidate-membership feature family evaluated on the already observed 401..1250 historical sample. It is not an independent prospective sample, is not statistically independent of other historical axes, and cannot count as prospective confirmation or be promoted from a historical pass alone.
hypothesis: For each candidate number, whether it appeared in the immediately preceding draw may contain cutoff-safe first-order transition information about next-draw inclusion. One fixed shrinkage estimator may improve a deterministic three-line disjoint union18 portfolio over the exact geometry-matched null.

feature_definition.source: The immediately preceding draw's six main numbers only; bonus is excluded.
feature_definition.class: For candidate n, state s is 1 if n appeared among the previous draw's six main numbers; otherwise s is 0.
feature_definition.state_range: s is binary 0 or 1 and is computed separately for each of the 45 candidate numbers.
feature_definition.candidate_universe: All integers 1..45 are scored for every target.
feature_definition.transition_history: For each historical outcome round u=2..t-1, use candidate n's membership in draw u-1 as the feature and main-number inclusion in draw u as the outcome. Score target t from draw t-1, then add target t only after scoring.

training_cutoff_rule: For target t, use only draws 1..t-1. For each historical outcome round u=2..t-1, use candidate n's membership in draw u-1 as the feature and main-number inclusion in draw u as the outcome. Score target t from draw t-1 and outcomes through t-1 only; add target draw t after scoring.

estimator.prior_mean: 6/45 main-number inclusion probability under the uniform 6-of-45 null

portfolio.geometry: Exactly three pairwise-disjoint six-number lines, union18.
portfolio.selection: Three sequential calls to the unchanged E045 choose_disjoint_ticket selector, passing the E069 score as both role_score and global_score; remove selected numbers after each line.

random_comparator.method: For each target, uniformly permute labels 1..45 jointly over the three fixed model lines, preserving three six-number lines, pairwise disjointness, union18, and line-incidence geometry.

inference.ci_method: Two-sided percentile moving-block bootstrap of per-target differences from the exact geometry-matched union18 null.

prospective_confirmation.readiness_rule: Even if the historical gate passes, do not create STRICT_PASS_READY or release purchase lines until the policy owner formally predeclares the prospective minimum target count and completion rule.

promotion_rule: Evaluate this single preregistered axis once. No variants, threshold changes, alpha changes, block-length changes, comparator changes, or parameter search after observing results. Historical evidence is exploratory across the already inspected study family; even a single-study historical gate pass cannot create STRICT_PASS_READY because prospective confirmation remains required and unspecified in policy.
research_question: Does a candidate number's membership in the immediately preceding draw provide cutoff-safe information about its inclusion in the next draw, sufficient to improve one frozen three-line disjoint union18 portfolio over the exact geometry-matched null?
novelty_statement: One frozen first-order candidate-membership transition family. It is distinct in lag definition from E053's lag-two candidate membership and from E068's aggregate overlap count across two previous draws; it is not a claim of statistical independence. One fixed estimator, one E045 selector, one historical evaluation; no variants or parameter search.
research_axis_multiplicity_note: Per-study four-metric Bonferroni adjustment does not control selection across the full set of historical research axes. Therefore this result is diagnostic only and cannot be promoted to purchase readiness, even if its within-study historical gate passes.
